name: SUNCON
recent: Sunway Construction 公布 2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 25% 至 RM105.1 million，并宣布每股 7.9 sen 的第三次中期股息。公司订单簿达到创纪录的 RM12.4 billion。同期，EPF 连续多日申报股权变动，公司也因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股。
notable: 2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 25% 至 RM105.1 million。
宣布第三次中期股息每股 7.9 sen。
订单簿达到创纪录的 RM12.4 billion。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 10 月底至 11 月中连续多日申报股权变动。
公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，最新总股本约 13.32 亿股。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季（截至 9 月 30 日）净利按年增长 25.4% 至 RM105.06 million，营收按年下降 25.8%；按季比较，净利下降 12.5%，净利率从 11.6% 降至 10.2%。

recent_en: Sunway Construction reported a 25% year-on-year rise in 3Q2026 net profit to RM105.1 million and declared a third interim dividend of 7.9 sen per share. Its order book reached a record RM12.4 billion. Meanwhile, EPF filed multiple successive changes in its substantial shareholder interest, and the company issued new shares several times due to ESOS exercises.
notable_en: 3Q2026 net profit rose 25% year-on-year to RM105.1 million.
Declared a third interim dividend of 7.9 sen per share.
Order book reached a record RM12.4 billion.
risks_en: EPF filed successive changes in its substantial shareholder interest from late October to mid-November 2026.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, with latest total issued shares at about 1.332 billion.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 (ended 30 Sep) net profit rose 25.4% year-on-year to RM105.06 million while revenue fell 25.8% year-on-year; quarter-on-quarter, net profit declined 12.5% and net margin narrowed from 11.6% to 10.2%.
